Newest "Notable changes" section is still **June 2026** — identical to the 2026-08-07, 2026-08-09 and
2026-08-10 captures. **No July or August 2026 section has been published**, even though the page's
updated_at advanced to 2026-08-11.

June 2026 (all reported 2026-08-07): new agent experience / GitHub Copilot harness
(production-ready preview); Microsoft IQ; skills; memory; Windows 365 for Agents MCP server (GA);
condition groups; voice agents with Teams Phone Agent (preview); connect other agents (preview);
Foundry IQ knowledge connection (preview); Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.5 Chat as primary model (GA).

Released versions page (power-platform/released-versions/copilotstudio, ms.date 2026-06-30,
updated_at 2026-07-01): still tops at platform **2026.6.3** / UX **26.06.21-24** (June 30, 2026) —
unchanged for a fourth consecutive scan and now ~6.5 weeks stale relative to the What's New page.
Regional spread unchanged: preview/France/Switzerland/Korea/Germany/South Africa/Norway/Canada/India/
Sweden/South America on 2026.6.3; UK/Asia/UAE/Japan/Europe on 2026.6.2; Australia/US/GCC on 2026.6.1.

Cross-reference (2026-08-14): Copilot Studio agents continue to appear in the tenant-wide
Entra ID -> Agent ID -> All agent identities inventory and in the Microsoft Agent 365 registry
(reported 2026-08-10). Nothing on this page changes that.
